statement.zh: **协议**：DTLS 1.2（DTLS 1.2）。摘要给出定位：「This document specifies version 1.2 of the Datagram Transport Layer Security (DTLS) protocol.The DTLS protocol provides communications privacy for datagram protocols.」并说明「This document updates DTLS 1.0 to work with TLS version 1.2.」。
statement.en: **Protocol**: DTLS 1.2 (DTLS 1.2).The abstract sets the scope: "This document specifies version 1.2 of the Datagram Transport Layer Security (DTLS) protocol.

statement.zh: 版本号的对齐策略写在 §1：「There is no DTLS 1.1; that version number was skipped in order to harmonize version numbers with TLS.」算法层则直接继承 TLS 1.2——§4.1.2.4 说明「The existing AEAD cipher suites, defined in [ECCGCM] and [RSAGCM], can be used with DTLS exactly as with TLS 1.2.」。
statement.en: Section 1 explains the numbering: "There is no DTLS 1.1; that version number was skipped in order to harmonize version numbers with TLS." The algorithm layer inherits TLS 1.2 outright — §4.1.2.4 says "The existing AEAD cipher suites, defined in [ECCGCM] and [RSAGCM], can be used with DTLS exactly as with TLS 1.2."。.

statement.zh: 与 TLS 最大的行为差异是容错：§4.1.2.7 规定无效记录「In general, invalid records SHOULD be silently discarded, thus preserving the association; however, an error MAY be logged for diagnostic purposes.」记录层本身则与 TLS 1.2 几乎相同，「The only change is the inclusion of an explicit sequence number in the record.」。
statement.en:
The behavioural difference from TLS is fault tolerance: §4.1.2.7 says "In general, invalid records SHOULD be silently discarded, thus preserving the association; however, an error MAY be logged for diagnostic purposes." The record layer itself is near-identical, "The only change is the inclusion of an explicit sequence number in the record."

statement.zh: 选择告警的代价被明确劝阻：实现若对无效记录产生告警，「MUST generate fatal level alerts to avoid attacks where the attacker repeatedly probes the implementation to see how it responds to various types of error.」，而在 UDP 上「this practice is NOT RECOMMENDED for such transports.」§4.1 另要求 epoch 与序号唯一——「implementations MUST NOT allow the same epoch value to be reused within two times the TCP maximum segment lifetime.」。
statement.en: Choosing alerts is actively discouraged: such implementations "MUST generate fatal level alerts to avoid attacks where the attacker repeatedly probes the implementation to see how it responds to various types of error.", and over UDP "this practice is NOT RECOMMENDED for such transports." Section 4.1 adds that "implementations MUST NOT allow the same epoch value to be reused within two times the TCP maximum segment lifetime."。.

本条的形式模型是 \(\mathrm{Adv}^{\Pi}_A(\lambda)\le n\cdot\mathrm{Adv}^{\mathrm{prf}}_F(\lambda)+\varepsilon_{\mathrm{aead}}(\lambda)\)。输入：输入：DTLS 1.2的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：Π 协议，A 敌手，n 会话数，PRF/AEAD 为底层原语。
